526:t_1:4.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「You're $$ミスリル$$'s $$ギャビン・ハンター$$, correct?」

526:t_1:5.en:
$$ハンター$$
「No use denying it, I suppose...」

526:t_1:6.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Don't think you can escape. You and the transport trailer are surrounded by four ASs.」

526:t_1:7.en:
$$ハンター$$
「You needn't tell me that. I'm well aware.」

526:t_1:8.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「We've already confirmed the cargo. Now we wait for Mr. K (Potassium) to make his call.」

526:t_1:9.en:
$$ハンター$$
(Mr. K... I hear $$アマルガム$$'s executives have codenames taken from chemical element symbols...)

526:t_1:10.en:
$$ハンター$$
(So one of them is coming here...?)

526:t_1:12.en:
$$アマルガム$$
「Not at all... Once we picked up these people's trail, it was an easy mission.」

526:t_1:15.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「It's been a long time, $$ハンター$$.」

526:t_1:16.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Mr. $$カリーニン$$! Why are you with $$アマルガム$$!?」

526:t_1:17.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「It's common enough in the mercenary world.」

526:t_1:18.en:
$$ハンター$$
「I had heard you went missing in the battle on $$メリダ島$$...」

526:t_1:19.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I've been shown the cargo.」

526:t_1:21.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「The ARX-8... Completing a successor to the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$ under these circumstances deserves praise.」

526:t_1:22.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「But building a thing like that won't change anything. It's wasted effort.」

526:t_1:23.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Mr. $$カリーニン$$... I never thought I would hear such words from your mouth.」

526:t_1:24.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Isn't that exactly why the wonderful young people aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ trusted you?」

526:t_1:25.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You give me too much credit.」

526:t_1:26.en:
$$ハンター$$
「So many of our comrades were killed! And that it should be you, of all people, how shameless...! Doesn't it pain you at all!?」

526:t_1:28.en:
$$ハンター$$
「Wait, Mr. $$カリーニン$$! Do you truly...」

526:t_1:31.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「That was a warning. ...Now, you will answer my questions.」

526:t_1:32.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Who assembled that unit, the ARX-8? And where are they?」

526:t_1:34.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「You have no intention of answering, then.」

526:t_1:36.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I shot you where it won't kill you instantly. Are you ready to talk?」

526:t_1:38.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I see... Then enjoy the time you have left until you die.」

526:t_1:40.en:
$$ハンター$$
($c now has to face enemies so formidable that $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped ASs are nothing by comparison...)

526:t_1:45.en:
$$レナード$$
「...I hear part of $c has landed on this Earth.」

526:t_1:46.en:
$$ファウラー$$
「The Empire reports that a unit believed to be them is operating on the Eastern Pacific front.」

526:t_1:47.en:
$$レナード$$
「No need to confirm it. It'll be $$テレサ$$ and the others.」

526:t_1:48.en:
$$レナード$$
「Knowing them, I'd say they've split into several units and are throwing the Empire's various fronts into disarray.」

526:t_1:49.en:
$$レナード$$
「And among them, $$テレサ$$ will surely come after me.」

526:t_1:51.en:
$$レナード$$
「Honestly... I'm utterly appalled at how that girl never knows when to give up.」

526:t_1:52.en:
$$レナード$$
「She was a bit better back in $$ミスリル$$, but ever since she joined $c, she's done nothing but make foolish choices...」

526:t_1:53.en:
$$レナード$$
「At this rate she's no different from those crude, vulgar, dreamy types who act on their emotions.」

526:t_1:54.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Also, according to Mr. K's report, the unit in question has been captured.」

526:t_1:55.en:
$$レナード$$
「The ARX-8, huh... That one interests me.」

526:t_1:56.en:
$$レナード$$
「After all, it's their last trump card.」

526:t_1:57.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Understood. I'll arrange to have it transferred here at once.」

526:t_1:58.en:
$$レナード$$
「$$ファウラー$$. I want you to keep track of what $$テレサ$$ and the others are doing.」

526:t_1:59.en:
$$ファウラー$$
「If they should head this way, what shall we do?」

526:t_1:60.en:
$$レナード$$
「If they ask for a face-to-face meeting, I suppose I wouldn't mind meeting them.」

526:t_1:62.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「Then, if you'll excuse us.」

526:t_1:63.en:
$$レナード$$
「Once the reports from $$カスパー$$ are all in, the preparations will be complete...」

526:t_1:64.en:
$$レナード$$
「...So, are you so curious about them that you'd eavesdrop?」

526:t_1:66.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's the first time in a long while I've seen life in your eyes.」

526:t_1:67.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Both $$ミスリル$$ and $c are still alive... He must be too...)

526:t_1:68.en:
$$かなめ$$
(And he's searching for me... Just to take me back to that town... to that school...)

526:t_1:69.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Even me, who practically betrayed him by going off with another man like that...)

526:t_1:70.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Compared to that, what am I even doing...? I think that growing old and dying in this boring mansion without doing anything will make up for something...)

526:t_1:71.en:
$$かなめ$$
(But... I want to see him... I want to see $$宗介$$...)

526:t_1:72.en:
$$レナード$$
「Is there anything you want? You seem thoroughly sick of this boring life.」

526:t_1:74.en:
$$レナード$$
「That much is fine. Though I'll have to cut the communication functions, of course.」

526:t_1:76.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll look for what I can do... And then I'll do it... Faster, stronger, forward, ever forward.)

526:t_1:77.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I'll charge ahead recklessly, just like that idiot. I'll be myself...)

526:t_1:81.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Run, run, run! A warrior who can't run can't win!」

526:t_1:84.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Thanks to the continued operations in space, your muscle strength and field combat instincts have declined! I'm going to retrain you from scratch right here!」

526:t_1:87.en:
$$カレン$$
「Have they been going like that since this morning?」

526:t_1:88.en:
$$アルト$$
「Not since this morning... They've been at it nonstop since midnight.」
